summary: Completed full backend (21 pytest tests) + frontend smoke/integration testing of GymPro. 21/21 backend tests passing after fixing 1 bug. Frontend login, dashboard, members, leads Kanban, trainers, settings, reports, and member detail all verified end-to-end with pre-seeded demo gym.

issues: X-axis shows duplicate 'Jan' label (likely because month-diff math uses timedelta(days=30) rather than relativedelta) - cosmetic

design_issues.screen: Dashboard > New Members per Month chart

action_items: (Optional) Use relativedelta for month-arithmetic in dashboard/stats revenueChart & newMembersChart to avoid duplicate month labels (currently uses 30-day jumps). Cosmetic only.
(Optional) Consider returning full gym object via `find_one` after insert in /auth/register instead of mutating input dict (already patched by testing agent to pop _id).
critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/register was returning 500 because motor's insert_one mutates the dict adding Mongo ObjectId `_id`, making the response non-JSON-serializable. Fixed by popping `_id` before returning.
Dashboard stats uses `timedelta(days=30)` for month stepping which produces duplicate 'Jan' labels across year boundaries; prefer calendar-aware stepping.
server.py is a single ~920 line file — consider splitting by domain (auth/members/payments/etc.) once feature scope grows past MVP.
No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /auth/login (not requested by spec, just a note).
CORS set to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — technically invalid CORS combination; browsers ignore credentials flag. Acceptable here because app uses Bearer tokens (not cookies).
test_credentials: demo@gympro.in / Demo@123 (pre-seeded on every backend startup)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used pre-seeded FitZone Gym: 45 members, 5 trainers, 8 leads, 4 plans, 3 months payments, 30 days attendance, 4 classes, 3 months expenses. Test-prefixed TEST_* data is created and cleaned up within each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_gympro_api.py — run via `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Fixed register endpoint (ObjectId pop). All dashboards/pages load with data. Frontend uses data-testid widely (e.g., login-demo-button, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button). Pre-seeded demo login flow via login-demo-button jumps straight to /app/dashboard.
rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/auth/register returned 500 Internal Server Error. RCA: motor's `insert_one(gym)` mutates the input dict in place adding a BSON ObjectId under `_id`. The same dict was then returned in the HTTP response -> Pydantic/FastAPI tried to JSON-serialize an ObjectId -> TypeError('ObjectId object is not iterable'). Fix: call `gym.pop('_id', None)` before returning. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with a valid fresh payload; observe 500 pre-fix, 200 post-fix. Verified with TestAuth.test_register_new_gym and TestMultiTenant.test_new_gym_sees_no_demo_data — both now pass.
